evals.prompt: Extract LinkedIn ads from this URL: https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=payoneer&payer=Payoneer
evals.expected_output: A JSON file containing structured data about LinkedIn ads from Payoneer, including ad count, ad details (about, impressions, targeting), saved as linkedin_ads_payoneer_<timestamp>.json
expectations: The output is a valid JSON file
The JSON contains a search_metadata section with total_ads_found
The JSON contains an ads array with at least one ad
Each ad has structured data including 'about', 'impressions', and 'targeting' sections
The skill used Playwright MCP tools (browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, etc.)
The skill scrolled the page 3 times to load more ads
The ad detail pages were visited and data was extracted

evals.prompt: I need to analyze competitor ads. Go to https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=microsoft&payer=Microsoft and extract all the ad data you can find. I'm particularly interested in the targeting criteria they use.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive JSON file with Microsoft LinkedIn ads data, with detailed targeting information for each ad
expectations: The output is a valid JSON file with Microsoft ads data
The targeting section is populated with available data (locations, job titles, industries, etc.)
Multiple ads were extracted (not just one)
The skill navigated to individual ad detail pages
The JSON structure follows the expected schema with about/impressions/targeting sections

evals.prompt: Extract LinkedIn advertising data from https://www.linkedin.com/ad-library/search?accountOwner=google&payer=Google. Make sure to get the ad creative URLs and landing pages.
evals.expected_output: JSON file with Google LinkedIn ads including creative URLs and landing page information
expectations: The output is a valid JSON file
Creative URLs are extracted and included in the 'about' section
The skill properly handled the infinite scroll
Data is structured according to the expected format
